_comment: BLANK brand file. Copy it to your brand's working folder ($SAC_WORKDIR/brand.json) and replace every [MISSING] from BRAND-KIT.md (section 'brand.json — key by key'). Scripts find it via scripts/sac_config.py: $BRAND_JSON > $SAC_WORKDIR/brand.json > this file (which only warns: it is the template). Filled example: the wildhorn-static-ads skill's brand.json. Keys starting with _ are notes.
name: [MISSING]
icon_description: [MISSING] the official logo file, pasted by script (never drawn by the model — D19)
product_lock: [MISSING] the BRAND product NAME <container>. Reproduce it exactly as in Image 1: <every visible packaging element in reading order>.
lock_extra: [MISSING] Leave every brand-logo spot outside the label EMPTY (plain background, no icon, no letters) — the official logo is pasted there by script afterwards.
_fonts_note: fonts_dir defaults to scripts/fonts (Anton, Montserrat, Oswald, Fredoka). Add brand fonts as {"Name": "/abs/path.ttf"}.

product.ingredient_visual: [MISSING] how the ingredient must look in an ad
product.capsule_visual: [MISSING] how the capsule / pill / powder looks

offer._note: site-only offers (autoship, subscription…) are NEVER mentioned in ads

_prices_note: Every $ amount in an ad must be in this list (B20). While it holds [MISSING], lint blocks any price.

avatar.who: [MISSING] age range + look of every person shown as the customer

mechanism: [MISSING] the hidden cause in plain words (+ the jargon never to print)
compliance: [MISSING] e.g. no fake testimonials presented as real

_visual_checks_example.msg: C2 generic capsule — show the ingredient inside a transparent capsule

logo_files._rule: D19: pasted by script in the template's logo slot; never upscaled
